findings.observation: Return-to-field resets all sprites and palettes but deliberately skips respawning the active remote ObjectEvent, leaving that object attached to a destroyed sprite identity that EnsureRemoteRenderer will neither adopt nor replace.
findings.impact: After an ordinary return from a menu, battle, or similar field transition, the remote remains permanently invisible while its active ObjectEvent slot stays occupied until a later warp or session reset.
findings.recommendation: Before sprite reset/rebuild, safely deactivate the proven owned remote ObjectEvent, or make the runtime reclaim the reserved orphan and recreate it; add a return-to-field teardown/recreation regression.
evidence: src/overworld.c:2344-2353 runs ResumeMap before InitObjectEventsReturnToField, and src/overworld.c:2552-2561 resets sprite data and frees every sprite palette during ResumeMap.
src/event_object_movement.c:2965-2975 skips CoopPresenceRuntime_IsRemoteObject entries in SpawnObjectEventsOnReturnToField, so the active remote ObjectEvent is not rebound to a new sprite.

src/coop/presence_runtime.c:471-495 finds that surviving ObjectEvent, fails FindOwnedSprite, and only abandons newly created objects; src/coop/presence_runtime.c:328-372 then relinquishes cached ownership without removing the orphan.

findings.observation: The A-button hook consumes an adjacent remote interaction before vanilla object lookup, while TryInteract never checks whether a real interactable ObjectEvent occupies the same target tile.
findings.impact: Because the nonblocking remote may overlap an NPC, boulder, decoration, or item, pressing A sends the remote interaction and suppresses the real object's script, directly violating the no-mask requirement.
findings.recommendation: Before consuming the remote interaction, resolve the target tile while excluding the remote and yield to any real interactable object; retain the no-fallthrough result only when the remote is the sole eligible target. Add an overlapping-NPC regression.
evidence: src/field_control_avatar.c:212-226 returns the remote CONSUMED_NO_LOCK result before calling TryStartInteractionScript.
src/coop/presence_runtime.c:802-825 validates logical remote adjacency but performs no real-object lookup before consuming A.

src/event_object_movement.c:6627-6645 makes overlap possible by excluding remotes from collision, while src/event_object_movement.c:3504-3519 can find an overlapping real object only if vanilla lookup is reached.

findings.observation: The renderer restarts the selected directional animation on every runtime update, even when neither direction nor animation changed.
findings.impact: StartSpriteAnimInDirection seeks the sprite animation back to command zero before each frame's AnimateSprites pass, so walking and running remotes remain on their first animation frame instead of animating.
findings.recommendation: Only start or seek the sprite animation when the desired direction or animation actually changes, and add a multi-frame runtime test that proves the animation command advances.
evidence: src/coop/presence_runtime.c:595-601 unconditionally calls StartSpriteAnimInDirection during every EnsureRemoteRenderer update invoked from src/overworld.c:1656-1662.
src/event_object_movement.c:8325-8329 delegates that call to SetAndStartSpriteAnim, and src/event_object_movement.c:10960-10965 calls SeekSpriteAnim at command index zero.
src/overworld.c:1810-1815 runs AnimateSprites after the per-frame runtime update, so the next update rewinds multi-frame animations before they can progress normally.

findings.observation: The new malformed-lifecycle regression reuses the rejected sequence with a same-epoch SESSION_READY and then expects a ROM_READY frame that the production same-epoch/already-ready branch never enqueues.
findings.impact: The required focused Cloud Coop test suite deterministically fails at the dequeue assertion, and the test does not actually prove that a valid lifecycle message can reuse the unconsumed outer sequence.
findings.recommendation: Reuse sequence 2 with a valid lifecycle frame and assert its reducer/pending effect, or change the assertion to the documented same-epoch SESSION_READY behavior; rerun the focused suite to a passing result.
evidence: test/coop/net_bridge.c:467-513 sends same-epoch SESSION_READY sequence 2 after the malformed spawn and expects CoopNetBridge_DequeueGameToNetwork plus ROM_READY.
src/coop/net_bridge.c:635-641 only updates rx_sequence and returns when SESSION_READY arrives for the already-ready current epoch; it does not enqueue ROM_READY.
rom-presence-activation-continuation-v2-worker-terminal.candidate.json records the focused Cloud Coop command as failed and RPA-008 as not_satisfied.

findings.observation: The staged presence runtime tests cover constants, pending admission, strict decode, and no-avatar epoch gating, but never execute the renderer, interpolation, interaction, warp, staleness, or return-to-field paths required by the acceptance contract.
findings.impact: Critical RPA-003 through RPA-007 behavior has no deterministic regression proof, allowing the renderer, animation, and interaction defects in this candidate to pass the worker's source-level acceptance claims; RPA-008 remains unresolved even apart from the failing bridge test.
findings.recommendation: Add deterministic runtime seams and focused tests for spawn/retry/ownership, six-frame interpolation and retargeting, animation progress, discontinuity snap, 90-frame staleness, warp and return-to-field teardown, overlap priority, queue-full interaction semantics, hidden publication, and local-link isolation, then run all contract commands.
evidence: test/coop/presence_runtime.c:62-179 contains four tests and never calls CoopPresenceRuntime_Update, CoopPresenceRuntime_TryInteract, CoopPresenceRuntime_AdvanceFrame, or CoopPresenceRuntime_OnWarpCommit.

findings.observation: The 90-frame stale path removes only the renderer, while TryInteract continues to treat the reducer's unchanged visible remote as interactable without checking lifecycle age or renderer presence.
findings.impact: After the remote disappears as stale, pressing A toward its old tile still attempts a 20-byte interaction and consumes the input indefinitely even though no remote avatar is visible.
findings.recommendation: Require a non-stale lifecycle and a presently proven remote renderer before consuming A, or clear/deactivate reducer visibility at stale teardown; add a 90-frame stale-interaction regression.
evidence: src/coop/presence_runtime.c:694-700 removes the renderer at the stale threshold but leaves the reducer state intact.
src/coop/presence_runtime.c:802-825 checks transport, local state, reducer visibility, and logical adjacency, but no stale-age or renderer-ownership predicate before returning CONSUMED_NO_LOCK.
